params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $r='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'; if (!(Test-Path $r)) { throw 'canonical repo missing' }; git -C $r fetch origin --prune; 'ORIGIN_MAIN='+(git -C $r rev-parse origin/main); 'STATUS'; git -C $r status --porcelain=v1 -b; 'WORKTREES'; git -C $r worktree list --porcelain; 'REMOTE_BRANCHES'; git -C $r for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname)' refs/remotes/origin | Sort-Object; 'OPEN_LOCAL_BRANCHES'; git -C $r branch --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname)'
